Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. You must trash their top security card if possible.
Card Q&A.q: Can I choose to not trash my opponent's top security card when I use this card's [End of All Turns] effect to delete 1 of my opponent's Digimon and 1 of their Tamers?

Effect: [When Digivolving] By playing 1 [Lucemon: Larva] from your trash to your empty breeding area without paying the cost, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers.
[End of All Turns] [Once Per Turn] Trash your opponent's top security card. If this effect didn't trash, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon and 1 of their Tamers.
